ModMetaData.name: Wardrobe Policy Sync
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
Version 1.1.0 — RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
Quickly apply an existing apparel policy to an outfit stand, including allowed apparel, quality, and durability settings.
Supports both adult and kid outfit stands.
Requires Harmony and Odyssey DLC.
